args.title: Corvid Packaging newsletter + linked article + companion
args.body:
- Newsletter: Corvid Packaging's latest issue covers "Freight pricing this quarter."
- Linked article (blog.corvid.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
